title: MissionForge pilot controls
description: Pilot controls per input device (design section 9.2).

$schema.description: Optional relative path to the JSON Schema of this file, for editor support. Loaders ignore it.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

control.description: One pilot action and its bindings.

id.description: Unique action ID, for example stage_separate.

name_key.description: String key of the Action column.

label_key.description: String key of the Keyboard column as printed.

inputs.description: Keyboard inputs of the action, in the order printed. Names of keys, buttons and sticks; not translated.

fine_modifiers.description: Inputs that switch the action to fine control while held.

combination.description: True if all inputs must be pressed together; otherwise each input is a separate direction, function or alternative.

hold.description: True if the input must be held to trigger the action.

hold_s.description: How long the input must be held, in seconds, where the design gives a time.

cycles.description: True if repeated presses cycle through the modes of the action.

label_key.description: String key of the Gamepad column as printed.

inputs.description: Gamepad inputs of the action, in the order printed. Names of keys, buttons and sticks; not translated.

fine_modifiers.description: Inputs that switch the action to fine control while held.

combination.description: True if all inputs must be pressed together; otherwise each input is a separate direction, function or alternative.

hold.description: True if the input must be held to trigger the action.

hold_s.description: How long the input must be held, in seconds, where the design gives a time.

cycles.description: True if repeated presses cycle through the modes of the action.

touch.description: Touch control on the host tablet.

label_key.description: String key of the Touch (host tablet) column as printed.

guarded.description: True if the touch control is guarded against accidental use.

modes.description: Modes or items the action covers, in the order printed (attitude-hold modes, deployable items).

host_only.description: True if only the host can use the action.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.
